hero.title: Bringing a Rare, Traditional Salt to Everyday Premium Kitchens
paragraphs: Bambaura was founded with a singular, honest purpose: to make authentic bamboo-roasted salt accessible to home cooks and chefs who appreciate rare culinary ingredients.

We believe extraordinary food comes from patient traditional craftsmanship, not industrial shortcuts or exaggerated wellness claims. By roasting pure sea salt inside mountain bamboo tubes across nine separate firings, we deliver a finishing salt that elevates everyday dining.
hero.quote: Our mission is simple: bringing a rare, traditional salt to everyday premium kitchens.

founderNote.headline: A Note from Our Founder
founderNote.story: When I first tasted nine-times roasted bamboo salt, its delicate smoky aroma and gentle egg-like umami note completely transformed a simple soft-boiled egg. I realized this centuries-old roasting craft deserved a place on modern kitchen tables—honest, lab-tested, and transparently sourced.

sourcing.title: Crafted by Artisanal Salt Masters
sourcing.description: Every batch is crafted in small traditional kilns using three honest, natural inputs:

inputs.name: Pristine Sea Salt
inputs.detail: Natural solar-evaporated sea salt, harvested without anti-caking chemicals or industrial bleach.

inputs.name: Mountain Bamboo Tubes
inputs.detail: Mature, thick mountain bamboo stalks, cut into natural firing tubes rich in sap and resin.

inputs.name: Yellow Mountain Clay
inputs.detail: Pure mineral yellow clay hand-molded to seal tube openings and lock in heat and aromatic smoke.

inputs.name: Pine Firewood Kilns
inputs.detail: High-resin pine firewood providing sustained high-heat temperatures over 21 roasting days.

sustainability.title: Thoughtful Packaging for Freshness & Table Presentation
sustainability.subtitle: Designed to keep your salt crisp, aromatic, and ready for everyday kitchen use:

commitments.title: Signature Canister
commitments.detail: Rigid, food-grade paperboard canister with snug lid, designed for elegant kitchen and dining display.

commitments.title: Barrier Freshness Pouch
commitments.detail: High-barrier inner foil pouch with resealable zip-lock to keep humidity out.

commitments.title: Everyday Finishing
commitments.detail: Fine uniform granules and coarse finishing crystals designed for a delicate tabletop pinch.

commitments.title: Transparent Batch Testing
commitments.detail: Every single batch is tested at an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory with verifiable COA.
